Patrizia plans to raise and deploy £1 billion ($1.32 billion) for essential housing across the United Kingdom, according to an Oct. 8 release.

Patrizia intends to expand its housing activity across U.K. growth cities and regions, working with metro mayors, combined authorities and local partners to identify opportunities that respond to local housing priorities. At the proposed scale of investment, the plan could support the delivery of 4,000 homes for 10,000 people over time.

The approach is designed to connect housing opportunities identified by mayoral authorities with long-term capital, potentially including U.K. pension investment. Mayors can shape local housing priorities and deploy funding, while Local Government Pension Scheme funds and their investment pools can consider suitable projects as part of their investment strategies. Patrizia는 메트로 시장, 광역 지자체 및 지역 파트너들과 협력하여 지역 주택 우선순위에 부합하는 투자 기회를 발굴함으로써 영국 내 성장 도시와 지역으로 주택 사업을 확대할 예정이다. 제안된 투자 규모로 볼 때, 이 계획은 향후 장기적으로 1만 명이 거주할 수 있는 4000채의 주택 공급을 지원할 수 있다.
